subject: skill/stack/chroma
claim: In Chroma, use .query for nearest-neighbor similarity search and .get for ID/pagination retrieval without ranking. Results are column-major (one array per field), and .query groups results per input query while .get is a flat list; n_results defaults to 10 and ids are always returned. Filter at query time with where (metadata equality/range) and where_document ($contains / regex), and control the payload with include. If the collection has no embedding function attached, supply query_embeddings whose dimension matches the stored embeddings.
notes: Query-and-get backs query vs get, the 10-result default, n_results/ids/where/where_document/include, the column-major QueryResult/GetResult shapes, and the embedding-dimension requirement. Introduction backs Chroma's metadata filtering plus dense/sparse/hybrid search and the Apache-2.0 self-host/cloud options. Both agree; low uncertainty. In the repo's RRF fusion Chroma is one candidate leg, so the hard per-cell scope should be pushed into where, never applied as a post-filter.
